ruleDefinitions.name: Telegram API Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious requests to Telegram API without the usual Telegram User-Agent Note: Unmapped fields: cs-host, c-useragent

sequences.query: cs-host = "api\.telegram\.org" AND  NOT ((c-useragent = RGX(".*Telegram.*") OR c-useragent = RGX(".*Bot.*")))
